correctness.rationale: The quotient has exact orbit cells and oriented boundary words from actual row assignments. Explicit tree contractions and one/two-cell eliminations remove each used generator with coefficient exactly once. Uniform substitutions for all n>=5 reduce all survivors to empty loops or powers x^3 and x^-3; one Moore attachment kills their pi1 classes, and every other two-cell attaches nullhomotopically. The sphere count follows exact cell arithmetic. A standard-library verifier independently checks orbit counts, boundary cycles and free-word reductions for n=3..11; finite tests are corroboration, not proof.
